This iCORE representation enables the auditor to certify two complementary properties: {Work soundness}, where every active decision-relevant work assertion must have a finite justification through $G$ and $Π$; and {Agent-assignment stability}, which requires that no feasible alternative agent improve the declared contribution value for an evaluated obligation by more than $ε$. We establish local-to-global soundness and assignment-regret guarantees and a performance bound under stated conditions. iCORE is an instrumentation layer over workflows. Numerical results show that the full coupled state exactly reconstructs soundness and assignment defects in two execution modes and that, relative to passive full-state observation, iCORE-Audit yields absolute trajectory-quality improvements of $11.5\%$ and $26.4\%$ in controlled and real-LLM execution, respectively, with corresponding absolute terminal-performance improvements of $15.1\%$ and $31.0\%$.

</details>


### [174] [Stop Shipping AI Agents on Faith: Capability Is Not Production Readiness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27677)
*Fouad Bousetouane*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出ProofAgent Index (PAI)，一个用于AI代理生产就绪性的治理就绪指数。PAI将部署证据整合为四个维度：评估（Evaluation）、上下文（Context）、合规（Compliance）和治理（Governance），并基于此构建了开源基础设施ProofAgent Harness。在医疗和金融两个高度监管领域的验证表明，PAI能携带独立的就绪信号，区分高风险与低风险配置，将代理发布从基于能力的决策转变为可审计的就绪决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理已进入生产工作流，但许多发布决策仍依赖能力信号、演示或行为测试，无法证明代理在真实生产约束下的运营能力。能力不等于生产就绪性，需要一种能够系统评估代理在部署环境中是否真正可用的治理就绪指标。

Method: 提出PAI四维就绪指数：1) Evaluation：测量观测行为；2) Context：测量塑造行为的运行环境；3) Compliance：测量与适用规则和控制的合规程度；4) Governance：测量组织在运行过程中能否授权、监控、审计和控制代理。PAI在开源的ProofAgent Harness基础设施中实现，用于可审计的AI代理评估与治理。

Result: 在医疗和金融两个高度监管领域的验证显示：PAI携带独立于能力之外的就绪信号，能有效区分高风险与低风险配置。具体发现包括：上下文工程对可靠性影响显著，能力提升可改善行为但不决定就绪性，治理证据必须保持可见而非被平均掉。

Conclusion: PAI将代理发布从基于信念的部署决策重构为可审计的就绪决策，为AI代理的生产部署提供了更严谨、可验证的治理框架。该框架强调就绪性是多维度的，需要综合考虑行为、环境、合规和治理四个方面的证据。

Abstract: AI agents are moving into production workflows where they retrieve information, call tools, maintain state, and act on behalf of users or organizations, but many release decisions still rely on capability signals, demos, or behavioral tests that do not show whether an agent is ready to operate under production constraints. Capability is therefore not production readiness. This paper introduces the ProofAgent Index (PAI), a governance readiness index for AI agents. PAI combines four dimensions of deployment evidence: Evaluation, Context, Compliance, and Governance. Evaluation measures observed behavior, Context measures the operating environment that shapes that behavior, Compliance measures alignment with applicable rules and controls, and Governance measures whether the organization can authorize, monitor, audit, and control the agent during operation. PAI is implemented inside ProofAgent Harness, an open source infrastructure for auditable AI agent evaluation and governance. Validation across two heavily regulated domains, healthcare and finance, shows that PAI carries held out readiness signal and separates higher risk from lower risk configurations. The results show that context engineering strongly changes reliability, capability improves behavior but does not determine readiness, and governance evidence must remain visible rather than averaged away. PAI reframes agent release from a faith based deployment decision into an auditable readiness decision.

</details>


### [175] [Scaling LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Systems: Design Principles and Architectural Scalability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27942)
*Linus Sander,Fengjunjie Pan,Vahid Zolfaghari,Andre Schamschurko,Nenad Petrovic,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文针对基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）架构设计缺乏系统化原则和可扩展性理解的问题，从先前工作中提炼出四条设计原则（简洁性、弹性反馈、带可选循环的顺序工作流、基于摘要的通信），并将其操作化为一个参考架构（拓扑形式化为约束有向工作流图）。通过在标准化终端系统工程基准上评估四种递增复杂度的配置（使用两种不同能力的LLM），发现：扩展能带来近似线性的成本增长下的准确率提升，但仅当底层LLM超过最小能力阈值时；性能在中等复杂度时达到峰值，随后因超时和评估限制而退化；一致性问题是所有扩展级别中的核心挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统具有通过协调专业化智能体实现集体智能、解决高度复杂任务的潜力，但其架构设计空间缺乏系统性整理，缺乏广泛建立的设计原则，且系统的可扩展性特征尚未被充分理解。

Method: 1) 从先前工作的结构化分析中提炼四条可扩展MAS架构设计原则；2) 将这些原则操作化为参考架构，其拓扑形式化为约束有向工作流图；3) 在标准化终端系统工程基准上，使用两种不同能力的LLM评估四种递增复杂度的配置。

Result: 扩展能带来约线性成本增长下的可度量准确率提升，但仅在底层LLM超过最小能力阈值时成立；性能在中等复杂度时达到峰值，随后因超时和评估限制而退化；一致性持续性问题在所有扩展级别中均作为核心挑战出现。

Conclusion: 为从业者提供了具体的设计指导，并指出一致性和评估标准化是未来研究的关键目标。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems have the potential to enable collective intelligence and scale toward solving highly complex tasks through coordinated ensembles of specialized agents. However, despite their theoretical potential, the architectural design space remains largely non-systematized and lacks broadly established design principles. Furthermore, the scalability characteristics of such systems are only partially understood so far. This paper makes two contributions. We first distill four design principles for scalable MAS architectures from a structured analysis of prior work: simplicity, elastic feedback, sequential workflows with optional loops, and summary-based communication. We operationalize these principles in a reference architecture whose topology is formalized as a constrained directed workflow graph, and we evaluate four configurations of increasing complexity on a standardized benchmark of terminal-based system engineering tasks using two LLMs of differing capability. Our findings show that scaling yields measurable accuracy improvements with approximately linear cost growth, but only when the underlying LLM exceeds a minimum capability threshold. Performance peaks at intermediate complexity, then degrades due to timeouts and evaluation limitations. In addition, persistent consistency issues emerge as a central challenge across all scaling levels. These results provide concrete design guidance for practitioners and highlight consistency and evaluation standardization as key targets for future research.

</details>


### [176] [Argonaut: Interactive Visual Exploration for Distributed Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27946)
*Srijoni Majumdar,Chuhao Qin,Evangelos Pournaras*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Argonaut 是一个轻量级、容器化的优化仪表盘，用于多智能体分散式离散选择优化。它支持用户上传数据集、构建智能体和选项、动态修改决策空间与参数，并运行多个算法后端以交互式可视化整个搜索过程，将分布式离散选择优化从黑盒计算转变为人在环中的过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式离散选择优化在分散式环境中难以探索和导航：理清其他智能体的选择、选择间的相互依赖关系以及它们如何共同达成全局目标，随着系统规模扩大变得难以处理。现有方法大多集中式且支持有限，仅可视化最终解或提供固定数据集上的算法后端，解决方案的达成过程仍是一个黑盒。

Method: Argonaut 提供交互式可视化仪表盘，用户可上传数据集、构建智能体和选项、动态修改决策空间及参数，并运行多种算法后端来检查每种配置如何塑造局部智能体决策及最终全局目标。系统基于 Node.js 接口，配有可扩展的 Java 和 Python 优化后端，将系统构建、优化与分析统一在一个交互循环中。

Result: 在真实世界的家庭用电、共享出行和传感器数据交换数据集上进行了评估，规模达5600个智能体和最多100万个暴力破解解。典型运行时间为200个智能体、100个决策属性，在30秒内完成。

Conclusion: Argonaut 是首个将系统构建、优化与分析整合在一个交互循环中的工具，使分布式离散选择优化成为人在环中的过程而非一次性黑盒计算，显著提升了搜索过程的可观测性和可探索性。

Abstract: Distributed discrete-choice optimization in decentralized settings is often hard to explore and navigate: disentangling what other agents choose, how their choices are interdependent, and how they collectively reach a global objective quickly becomes intractable as the system scales. The major limitation is observability of the search process. Existing methods are largely centralized and offer limited support, visualizing only the final solution or providing algorithm backends over a fixed dataset, so how a solution is reached stays a black box. We present Argonaut, a lightweight, containerized optimization dashboard that enables interactive, visual exploration of the entire search process for multi-agent discrete-choice optimization in decentralized settings. Users upload datasets, construct agents and options, modify the decision space and its parameters on the fly, and run multiple algorithm backends to inspect how each configuration shapes local agent decisions and the resulting global objective. By uniting system construction, optimization, and analysis in one interactive loop, the first of its kind, Argonaut makes distributed discrete-choice optimization a human-in-the-loop process rather than a one-shot, black-box computation. We evaluate Argonaut on real-world household-electricity, shared-mobility, and sensor-data-exchange datasets scaling to 5600 agents and up to 1M solutions under brute force. Built on a Node.js interface with extensible Java and Python optimization backends, it maintains a typical runtime of 200 agents over 100 decision attributes in under 30 seconds.

</details>


### [177] [$Σ$-Mem: An Online Reliability Memory for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27958)
*Peilin Feng,Suorong Yang,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Σ-Mem是一个在线可靠性记忆系统，记录个体智能体的历史能力证据和智能体间关系证据，通过谱理论保证的稳定更新机制，实现无需重训练的多智能体自适应协调，在五个Qwen模型上验证了其泛化性和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统主要保留交互内容，而非建模"哪些智能体可信赖以及在何种条件下可信赖"。在无法直接验证多智能体响应的场景中，这一缺失尤为关键，因此需要一种专门记录可靠性证据的记忆机制。

Method: Σ-Mem维护两类证据：个体智能体的历史能力证据和智能体间的关系证据，均以实对称矩阵形式存储，并从决策后的正确性反馈中更新。利用Weyl不等式保证每次事件级更新的谱变化有界，实现稳定的在线适应。提供统一的读写接口，可支持中心模型残差引导、无响应路由和可靠性加权投票三种使用方式。

Result: 在五个Qwen系列模型上，Σ-Mem能够适应反事实的可靠性变化，泛化到未见过的智能体和任务域。直接记忆读取在完整OOD评估集上优于多数投票和最佳固定智能体。随着更多正确性反馈的积累，性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 可靠性记忆可作为LLM多智能体系统中自适应协调的可复用基础设施，为建立可信智能体协作提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Memory is central to long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing memory systems primarily preserve interaction content rather than modeling which agents can be trusted and under what conditions. This limitation is particularly important in multi-agent systems, where a central model may be unable to directly verify plausible or correlated peer responses. We introduce $Σ$-Mem, an online reliability memory that records historical competence evidence for individual peers and peer relationship evidence across the peer set. Both forms of evidence are maintained as real symmetric states and updated from post-decision correctness feedback. By Weyl's inequality, the spectral change caused by each event-level update is bounded, enabling stable online adaptation without retraining the underlying models. $Σ$-Mem provides a general write-and-read interface: the same memory can be used for residual steering of a central model, response-free peer routing, or reliability-weighted voting. Across five Qwen-family models, $Σ$-Mem adapts to counterfactual reliability shifts and generalizes to unseen peers and task domains. Direct memory readouts also outperform majority voting and the best fixed peer over the full OOD evaluation set. Moreover, performance improves consistently as more correctness feedback becomes available, indicating that $Σ$-Mem progressively accumulates actionable reliability information. These results establish reliability memory as a reusable foundation for adaptive coordination in LLM-based multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [178] [VISA: A Structured Description Protocol for Agent-Based Simulation Models Towards Machine Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28027)
*Zhou He*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: VISA是一种结构化的、基于符号的ABM描述协议，通过八张互联表格和十九条可执行一致性规则，使智能体模型变得机器可解析、无歧义且可复现。作者用三个外部ABM验证了该协议，成功跨语言复现两个模型，并诚实地标明了第三个模型的复现障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体模型（ABMs）难以复现，因为其行为散布在散文叙述、平台特定代码和隐含假设中，两位读者从相同文档中常常重建出不同的模型。这严重制约了科学可复现性。

Method: 提出VISA协议：用八张互联表格（代理层四张：Agent、Variable、Sensing、Internal Function；模型层四张：Associated Data、Input/Output、Schedule、Validation）描述模型，遵循最小性与完备性原则。配套两个工具：十九条可执行一致性规则使模型有效性成为可检验属性；三个可复用的LLM可执行技能（编写、检查、代码生成）实现完整的"编写-检查-代码-复现"闭环。

Result: 在三个外部独立编写的ABM上验证：成功从VISA规范跨语言复现两个模型（NetLogo到Python）；第三个工业AnyLogic模型成功用八张表捕获并通过全部十九条规则，同时诚实标明了因专有移动库和不可用数据导致的复现障碍。

Conclusion: VISA将复现障碍从模型中不可见的部分转移到被命名且可定位的依赖项上，使复现问题变得可操作而不再隐晦。

Abstract: Agent-based models (ABMs) are difficult to reproduce: their behavior is spread across prose narratives, platform-specific code, and implicit assumptions, so that two readers routinely reconstruct different models from the same documentation. We present VISA, a structured, symbol-based description protocol that specifies a model in eight interconnected tables---four at the agent level (Agent, Variable, Sensing, Internal Function) and four at the model level (Associated Data, Input/Output, Schedule, Validation)---under the principle of minimality with completeness. VISA makes a model machine-parseable and unambiguous via two artifacts: nineteen executable consistency rules that turn model validity into a checkable property, and three reusable LLM-executable skills (authoring, checking, and code generation) that operationalize the full author--check--code--reproduce loop. We validate the protocol on three external, independently authored ABMs spanning three platforms: we reproduce two cross-language (NetLogo to Python) directly from their VISA specifications, and we capture a third, an industrial AnyLogic model, in eight tables (passing all nineteen rules) while honestly demarcating where reproduction is blocked by a proprietary movement library and unavailable data---itself a transparency contribution. VISA moves the reproduction barrier from the model, where it is invisible, to a named, localized dependency, where it is actionable.

</details>


### [179] [AgentRadio: Passive Awareness for Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28430)
*Xinxing Ren,Qianbo Zang,Ziyan Wang,Caelum Forder,Suman Deb,Peter Carroll,Zekun Guo*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: AgentRadio是一个异步消息传递层，为编码智能体提供线程、消息和提及等待三种原语，使多个智能体在长时程代码理解任务中能够被动感知队友发现并融入当前任务，无需在阶段边界才能通信。在SWE-Atlas QnA基准上，四个智能体组成的AgentRadio解决了62.1%的任务，比单个智能体高出29.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型代码库理解是LLM智能体的长时程任务，单个智能体成功率低（仅32.3%）。虽然分工可以缓解这一限制，但代码理解子任务相互依赖——一个智能体的发现可能重写另一个的任务，因此智能体需要在执行过程中协调，而非仅在阶段边界。现有多智能体系统只能在阶段之间通过交接或同步轮次进行通信，通信与工作互斥，执行中途的发现无法及时共享。

Method: AgentRadio是一个异步消息传递层，为编码智能体框架提供三个原语：(1) 线程（threads）、(2) 消息（messages）、(3) 等待提及（waiting for mentions）。最后一种作为后台任务运行，能够在不停顿前台工作的前提下浮现队友的消息，使每个智能体保持对同伴的被动感知，并将新发现融入持续中的任务。该框架采用五阶段协议进行分工与协商，组织四个智能体协同工作。

Result: 在SWE-Atlas QnA基准上，AgentRadio组织的四个智能体解决了62.1%的任务，比单个Opus 4.6智能体（32.3%）高出29.8个百分点，也超过了使用更新版Opus 4.8的Claude Code（57.2%）。Rubric级分析显示收益随任务难度增加而增长，与执行中修正作为底层机制的解释一致。

Conclusion: AgentRadio通过实现执行期间的后台异步通信，解决了多智能体代码理解系统中"工作与通信互斥"的根本限制，证明在执行中持续协调比阶段边界的同步交接更有效，且增益随任务难度增大而提升。

Abstract: Understanding large codebases is a long-horizon task for Large Language Model (LLM) agents: answering a single question can require building and running the software, tracing execution across files, and synthesizing evidence over tens of minutes. On SWE-Atlas QnA, a benchmark of long-horizon questions over production repositories, a single Claude Code agent (Opus 4.6) resolves only 32.3% of tasks. Dividing the work among agents with clean contexts mitigates this limitation. However, the subtasks of code comprehension are interdependent. One agent's findings can rewrite another's task, so agents must coordinate during execution, not only at phase boundaries. Existing multi-agent systems support such exchange only between phases, through staged handoffs or synchronized rounds. Communication and work remain mutually exclusive. A discovery made mid-execution cannot be shared until the next boundary. We present AgentRadio, an asynchronous message-passing layer that equips coding-agent harnesses with three primitives: threads, messages, and waiting for mentions. The last runs as a background task, surfacing teammates' messages without interrupting foreground work, so each agent remains passively aware of its peers and folds new findings into its ongoing task. Under a five-phase protocol of division of labor and negotiation, four agents organized by AgentRadio resolve 62.1% of tasks, 29.8 points above a single agent and above Claude Code with the newer Opus 4.8 (57.2%). Rubric-level analysis shows the gain growing with task difficulty, consistent with mid-course correction as the underlying mechanism. Our code is available at https://github.com/Coral-Protocol/AgentRadio.

</details>


### [180] [Using Theory of Mind to Arbitrate between Social and Non-social Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28601)
*Lance Ying,Ryan Truong,Joshua B. Tenenbaum,Samuel J. Gershman*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出"理性心智化模型"（Rational Mentalizing model）来解释人们如何在社交学习与非社交学习之间进行权衡。该模型通过推理他人目标和未来行动的信息量来估计社交学习的效用，然后将其与非社交学习的效用进行比较。通过一个新设计的博弈游戏，模型能够定量捕获人类在两种策略之间的权衡，表明选择性社交学习由"心智理论"驱动并服务于效用最大化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交学习是人类学习的重要机制，但人们有时会选择直接经验而非社交学习（后者可能带来时间和认知资源成本）。现有研究尚未清楚解释人们如何在社交学习与非社交学习之间做出平衡决策，因此需要一个计算模型来理解这一权衡过程。

Method: 提出了Rational Mentalizing模型，该模型包含两个关键步骤：(1) 通过推理他人的目标以及其未来行动的信息量来估计社交学习的效用；(2) 将社交学习效用与非社交学习效用进行对比权衡。研究者设计了一个新颖的博弈游戏，让玩家在观察他人与探索环境之间进行选择，并用该模型对行为数据进行定量拟合。

Result: Rational Mentalizing模型能够定量捕获人类在社交学习与非社交学习策略之间的权衡行为，即模型预测与人类实际行为高度一致。

Conclusion: 选择性社交学习是由"心智理论"（Theory of Mind）驱动的，其本质是在效用最大化框架下对社交与非社交信息获取策略进行理性权衡。

Abstract: Social learning is a powerful mechanism through which agents learn about the world from others. However, humans sometimes choose direct experience over social learning, which can carry time and cognitive resource costs. How do people balance social and non-social learning? We propose a Rational Mentalizing model of the decision to engage in social learning. This model estimates the utility of social learning by reasoning about another agent's goal and the informativeness of their future actions. It then weighs the utility of social learning against the utility of non-social learning. Using a novel game where players choose between observing other agents or exploring the environment, we show that the Rational Mentalizing model can quantitatively capture human trade-offs between these strategies. These findings suggest that selective social learning is guided by 'Theory of Mind' in the service of utility maximization.

</details>

### [181] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并系统评估了三种递归Transformer架构（Tiny Recursive Model、Depth Recursive transformer和简单递归transformer），用于工程设计中替代昂贵的首性原理仿真。在低维小数据集场景下，递归权重共享的Transformer能在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得有效且可泛化的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Transformer架构在工程设计中典型的低维小数据集上往往参数过拟合，导致过拟合而非精度提升，同时增加不必要的存储和计算开销。这促使研究者转向关注增加计算而非增加可学习参数的架构设计。

Method: 提出硬件感知的评估框架，对比三种递归Transformer范式：Tiny Recursive Model、提出的Depth Recursive transformer和简单recursive transformer，在预测性能（Recall、MRR）、参数量和FLOPs方面进行系统比较，并在两个低维工程预测任务（半导体封装热机械可靠性分析、Laplace PDE迭代数值求解器）上验证。

Result: 在两个低维工程预测任务上验证了递归权重共享Transformer的有效性，证明了其在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间的权衡优势，适用于小数据工程代理建模。

Conclusion: 递归Transformer（特别是递归权重共享机制）在资源受限的小数据工程代理建模场景下，提供了一种有效且可泛化的权衡方案，并给出了选择递归Transformer架构的实用设计指南。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.

</details>


### [182] [Regularizing modality contribution drift in multimodal continual learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27260)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Bin Liu,Tianrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模态贡献漂移（MCD）概念，揭示多模态持续学习（MMCL）中模态贡献结构不稳定导致灾难性遗忘的问题，并提出CMCDR正则化方法（含replay和replay-free两种版本）来保持旧任务的模态贡献结构，在多个MMCL任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MMCL方法主要关注跨模态表示对齐或语义相似性，但忽略了各模态相对贡献及其交互作用在增量任务间是否保持稳定。这种决策层面的漂移（MCD）是导致遗忘的一个重要被忽视因素，且现有方法无法可靠缓解此问题。

Method: 1) 提出MCD分数量化模态贡献漂移，结合贡献强度与相对依赖变化，通过受控的模态子集干预测量。2) 提出CMCDR框架：replay版本利用存储的旧样本作为诊断探针，比较当前模型与冻结旧模型的模态贡献分布并约束其变化；replay-free版本利用当前任务样本作为探针，蒸馏冻结模型的旧任务贡献响应，无需旧样本也能正则化贡献分布。

Result: 在多模态类增量学习和持续视觉问答任务上验证了CMCDR的通用性和有效性，实验表明该方法能有效缓解MCD并提升持续学习性能。

Conclusion: 模态贡献结构（而非仅表示对齐）是MMCL中保持旧知识的关键维度，CMCDR通过显式约束模态贡献漂移，在有无replay样本两种设置下均能有效缓解遗忘，为MMCL提供了新的正则化视角。

Abstract: Multimodal continual learning (MMCL) aims to learn emerging knowledge from multimodal data while preserving knowledge. To mitigate forgetting, current MMCL methods usually focus on cross-modal representation alignment or semantic similarity, but they overlook whether the relative contributions of individual modalities and their interactions remain stable across incremental tasks. We term this decision-level shift Modality Contribution Drift (MCD) and quantify it with the MCD score, which combines contribution-strength and relative-reliance changes under controlled interventions on modality subsets. Theoretical and empirical analyses further explain why current MMCL methods cannot reliably mitigate this drift. To this end, we propose Continual Modality Contribution Drift Regularization (CMCDR), which preserves the modality contribution structure of previously learned tasks. Since MMCL settings differ in whether old exemplars are available, CMCDR includes both replay-based and replay-free versions. The replay-based version uses modality-subset interventions as diagnostic probes on stored old samples, compares their contribution profiles between the current model and a frozen previous model, and constrains changes in old-sample modality-specific and interaction contributions. The replay-free version uses current-task samples as probes and distills the frozen model's old-task contribution responses, thereby regularizing the observed contribution profile without exemplars. Experiments on multimodal class-incremental learning and continual visual question answering validate the generality and effectiveness of CMCDR.

</details>


### [183] [DoTime: A Synthetic Benchmark Generator for Interventional and Counterfactual Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27263)
*Dennis Thumm,Billy Tim Anthony,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DoTime，一个开源、可扩展、有理论基础的多元时间序列结构因果模型（TSCM）生成器，支持干预和反事实估计，并作为因果基础模型的先验，发布为PyPI包及四个冻结评估套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果推断基准大多基于观测数据、规模小或领域特定，缺乏适合干预和反事实估计的基准，而这些在医疗、政策和气候科学等关键领域尤为重要。

Method: DoTime生成器引入多项新能力：连续时间干预窗口、带正性保护的反事实采样模式、 regime切换SCM（严格推广中断时间序列）、通过切换SCM参数实现非平稳动态、确定性斜坡和正弦干预剖面将趋势和结构断点置于评估窗口内。同时作为因果基础模型参考实现的先验。

Result: 发布包含100,000条轨迹的训练规模快照和八个具名识别结构，均具有精确ground truth。在结构匹配的held-out评估中，干预先验拟合网络（PFN）的差距在所有结构、轨迹长度和种子上均为正。

Conclusion: 论文提出可证伪的声明：干预训练比同容量观测模型在方向精度上具有可测量的优势，且实验在所有测试条件下均验证了该优势，表明DoTime生成器适用于因果基础模型先验。

Abstract: Most benchmarks for causal inference over time series are observational, small, or domain-specific, leaving interventional and counterfactual estimation under-served exactly where it matters most, such as in healthcare, policy evaluation, and climate science. We introduce \textbf{DoTime}, an open, scalable, and theoretically grounded generator of multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, released as the \code{dotime} PyPI package together with four frozen evaluation suites. Beyond existing work, it adds capabilities absent from prior generators: continuous-time intervention \emph{windows}, counterfactual sampling modes with a positivity guard, regime-switching SCMs as a strict generalization of interrupted time series, non-stationary dynamics by construction with switching SCM parameters, and deterministic ramp and sinusoidal intervention profiles that place trends and structural breaks \emph{inside} the evaluation window. Moreover, it demonstrates the suitability of the generator as a prior for a causal foundation model reference implementation. The released suites span a training-scale snapshot of $100{,}000$ trajectories and eight named identification structures, each with exact ground truth: paired interventional trajectories from the same SCM throughout, and shared-noise counterfactuals in the continuous-time suite. We ship reference baseline implementations with an evaluation harness, and pose a falsifiable claim: interventional training buys a measurable direction-accuracy advantage over an observational model of identical capacity. It is tested across three training seeds per arm. Under structure-matched evaluation on held-out episodes, the interventional prior-fitted network's (PFN) gap is positive in every structure, trajectory length, and seed tested.

</details>


### [184] [PlatformBid: An Auto-Bidding Benchmark from a Unified Advertising Platform's Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27265)
*Shengtian Yang,Yewen Li,Peng Jiang,Zhiyi Lyu,Bo An,Peng Jiang,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PlatformBid——首个从统一广告平台视角构建的自动出价综合基准，涵盖同质竞争、异质竞争和促销竞争三种真实场景，系统评估了包括经典控制、强化学习和生成式方法在内的多种现有方法，并提出基于流匹配的新型自动出价方法BidFlow。在快手平台的在线实验显示目标成本提升0.68%，验证了离线-在线一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动出价算法仅从DSP侧出发，以最大化广告主转化为目标。然而当前大型广告平台（社交媒体、电商等）已内部整合SSP、DSP和Ad Exchange功能，平台视角下自动出价的目标不仅是广告主转化，还要最大化平台总收益。由于缺乏平台中心的评估框架，作者提出PlatformBid来推动自动出价研究。

Method: PlatformBid基准定义了三种代表性场景：(1)同质竞争——所有广告主使用相同算法；(2)异质竞争——广告主采用多样化算法策略；(3)促销竞争——部分广告主在促销活动期间大幅增加预算。系统评估了经典控制方法、基于强化学习的方法和近年来的生成式方法。此外提出BidFlow，一种基于流匹配的新型自动出价方法，利用流匹配方法强大的策略表达能力来应对动态竞争环境。

Result: 在快手平台进行了在线实验，BidFlow在目标成本上实现了+0.68%的提升，为PlatformBid的离线-在线一致性提供了部署证据。

Conclusion: PlatformBid是首个从统一广告平台视角设计的自动出价基准，为自动出价研究提供了更贴近现实场景的评估框架。BidFlow方法的成功验证了流匹配在自动出价领域的潜力，同时在线实验结果证明了该基准在实际部署中的可靠性。

Abstract: Real-time bidding is central to computational advertising, comprising three elements: Supply Side Platform (SSP) selling ad impressions, Demand Side Platform (DSP) bidding for advertisers, and Ad Exchange conducting auctions between them. Traditional auto-bidding algorithms focus solely on the DSP side, maximizing advertiser conversions by adjusting bids against competitors. However, current big ad platforms, such as social media and e-commerce companies, now integrate SSP, DSP, and Ad Exchange functions internally. From such ad platforms' perspective, the goal of the auto-bidding algorithms is not only to maximize the advertisers' conversions, but also the total revenue of the platform. Given the lack of platform-centric evaluation frameworks and the pressing need to advance auto-bidding research, we propose PlatformBid - the first comprehensive benchmark designed from a unified ad platform's perspective. To accurately reflect the real-world auto-bidding scenarios, we define three representative settings: (1) homogeneous competition with identical algorithms across advertisers, (2) heterogeneous competition with diverse algorithmic strategies, and (3) promotional competition where some advertisers surge budgets for boosting sales during promotional events like Black Friday. We systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of existing auto-bidding methods across these settings, encompassing classical control methods, RL-based methods, and recent generative methods. Besides these methods, we further propose a novel auto-bidding method based on flow-matching, termed BidFlow, which leverages the flow-matching method's expressive policy representation to effectively handle dynamic competitive environments. Online experiments on Kuaishou further show a +0.68\% improvement in target cost, providing deployment evidence for the offline-online consistency of PlatformBid.

</details>


### [185] [Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27269)
*Weiye Shi,Fanxu Meng,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"功能重构"（Functional Reconstruction）的端到端方法，用于在将MHA/GQA模型转换为MLA（多头潜在注意力）后，通过优化每个转换后的注意力模块以复现原始模型的输出投影响应，从而恢复推测解码（speculative decoding）中的草稿token接受率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA因压缩KV缓存而具备长上下文推理的效率优势，但大多数现有模型使用MHA/GQA，需要转换才能获得MLA的缓存效率。然而，直接转换会引入注意力函数误差，虽然对独立生成影响不大，但会显著降低推测解码中草稿token的接受率，从而削弱加速效果。

Method: 将MLA草稿构建视作功能重构问题而非简单的缓存压缩。提出的端到端方法在转换后，对每个MLA注意力模块进行优化，使其在校准隐藏状态上复现原始MHA/GQA对应模块经输出投影后的响应。该方法与转换工具无关，保留转换后的缓存和推理图，且不需要验证器的logits或监督信号。

Result: 在192种配置（涵盖4对Llama/Qwen草稿-目标模型组合、TransMLA与MHA2MLA转换器、HF与vLLM后端、4个200提示词任务）的评估中，以0.5个百分点为报告容差，功能重构在64个匹配任务单元中实质性改善了37个的接受率，26个基本不变，仅1个实质性下降。

Conclusion: 功能重构作为一种转换器无关的后转换优化方法，能有效恢复MHA/GQA转MLA后推测解码的草稿接受率，且不改变转换后的缓存结构和推理图，为MLA在实际推理系统中的采用提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. With a 0.5-percentage-point reporting tolerance, Functional Reconstruction materially improves acceptance in 37 of 64 matched task cells, leaves 26 practically unchanged, and materially decreases one. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/swyhahaha/FunctionalMLA.

</details>


### [186] [RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27271)
*Huihao Jing,Haozhe Cui,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Changxuan Fan,Yuxuan Liu,Hanyu Yang,Sirui Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLPF（基于性能反馈的强化学习），一种分阶段的奖励机制，用于训练代码代理生成更快且正确的程序。阶段化奖励先按执行进度排序失败程序，再按相对基线到专家参考的改进程度对正确程序排序，从而在正确性之前提供有效反馈，正确性之后提供性能敏感反馈。在PerfCodeBench上，Qwen3-32B的正确且可运行解决方案从11.1%提升到54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升到38.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码模型训练虽越来越多使用执行反馈，但训练信号通常止步于正确性，忽略了系统代码中两个程序可能通过相同测试但运行时间差异巨大的问题。运行时间作为奖励信号面临三方面困难：仅在程序正确后才有意义、跨任务变化大、当大多数采样程序无法编译或运行时几乎无指导作用。因此需要一种能在正确性之前就提供有用反馈的训练方法。

Method: RLPF将执行结果转化为分阶段的奖励信号：(1) 对失败的程序，按执行进度进行排序，提供正确性之前的反馈；(2) 对正确的程序，根据其相对于基线到专家参考的改进程度进行排名，提供性能敏感反馈。该方法在Qwen3-32B上微调，综合了执行进度排序和相对效率排序两方面的奖励信号。

Result: 在PerfCodeBench上，RLPF将正确且可运行的解决方案从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。训练后的模型具有与更强开源系统竞争的能力，其优化行为可适度迁移至EffiBench-X。额外研究表明模型生成的参考提供有用但较弱的监督，完整的复合奖励比仅正确性或仅运行时间的基线更可靠。

Conclusion: 代码代理不仅可以被训练来通过测试，还可以被训练来优化其编写的程序的性能。分阶段的奖励设计有效解决了运行时奖励的脆弱性问题，表明将效率作为训练目标而非仅为评估指标是可行且有价值的。

Abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.

</details>


### [187] [SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27273)
*Jinliang Gao,Ning Yang,Hai Wang,Baili Xiao,Pin Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDO（结构感知数据组织）框架，通过暴露驱动的反馈机制动态组织mini-batch组成和样本暴露。在冻结外部嵌入上逐epoch操作，epoch内通过KNN邻域遍历形成连贯batch，epoch间通过暴露平衡调度减少过度暴露样本的采样概率。在SFT、DPO和GRPO上加速收敛，产生更连贯的梯度和更均衡的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型后训练成本高昂，现有效率改进主要聚焦于样本选择或训练调度，但数据组织本身被视为静态预处理步骤：基于嵌入的分组方法在训练前构建固定分区，无法适应优化过程中样本暴露的动态变化。导致所有样本获得相似的暴露程度，忽略其不同的优化需求——部分样本冗余更新，部分样本欠优化。

Method: SDO框架包含两个核心机制：(1) epoch内的局部敏感批处理：通过KNN邻域遍历将表示空间中相近的样本组成连贯的mini-batch；(2) epoch间的暴露平衡调度：记录每个样本的参与次数，降低过度暴露样本的采样概率以保持长期覆盖。框架基于冻结的外部嵌入运行，避免模型warm-up训练开销，且具有即插即用特性。

Result: 在SFT、DPO和GRPO三种训练范式上，SDO均加速了收敛，最大收益出现在训练的早中期阶段；产生更连贯的梯度，并在不同问题类型间实现更均衡的准确率，同时不会永久排除训练样本。

Conclusion: SDO通过将数据结构感知与暴露动态反馈相结合，将数据组织从静态预处理转变为自适应过程，在不牺牲样本覆盖的前提下提升后训练效率，是一种轻量且通用的数据组织优化方案。

Abstract: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.

</details>


### [188] [Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27274)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zeyuan Li,Zhiyi Lu,Jiacheng Hao,Youlang Du,Zhen Jiang,Xinche Zhang,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BridgeMIL，一种两阶段框架，将实例表示学习与受试者级监督解耦，用于基于EEG的疾病诊断。第一阶段通过时间邻近窗口对齐和子袋内对比学习预训练编码器，第二阶段通过注意力MIL聚合器进行受试者级监督分类，在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个骨干网络上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG疾病诊断的常见流水线将记录分段为短实例并为每个实例继承受试者标签，这假设所有实例提供同等可靠的诊断证据，且忽略了真正需要的是每位受试者的一个预测。MIL方法虽然避免继承标签，但EEG数据集中受试者数量远少于实例数量，限制了端到端MIL学习表征的质量。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 阶段一：无继承标签的预训练。通过对齐时间上邻近的窗口和独立采样的受试者内子袋来训练编码器，并加入方差和协方差正则化防止坍缩和减少冗余，无需负样本对。(2) 阶段二：将编码器迁移到基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对受试者预测施加监督，并通过特征保留限制表征漂移。

Result: 在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个代表性骨干网络上，BridgeMIL在15种数据集-骨干组合中14种取得最高平均准确率，整体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高出4.28个百分点。进一步分析显示继承标签可靠性因实例差异显著、性能对受试者稀缺性比对实例稀缺性更敏感，且表征空间更具结构化（受试者级聚簇更明显，诊断类别分离度更好）。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将监督与受试者级预测目标对齐，同时从丰富的EEG实例中学习而不为单个实例分配疾病标签，对EEG疾病诊断至关重要。BridgeMIL通过分离实例表征学习和受试者级监督，有效解决了继承标签不可靠和受试者稀缺的问题。

Abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

</details>


### [189] [Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27275)
*Jiwon Jang,Kisu Yang,Heuiseok Lim,Hyunwoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验了4-bit权重量化对多轮工具调用agent的影响，发现标准指标下量化看似无损，但通过更细粒度的过程诊断（错误率、缩小的错误预算）揭示量化实际上放大了模型已有的失败模式（如工具名幻觉），只是被基准的十个错误预算掩盖了。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化到4-bit权重被广泛报道为近乎无损，但作者质疑这一结论在多轮工具调用agent场景（当前最重要的应用场景之一）是否成立。标准指标可能掩盖了量化带来的真实损伤。

Method: 在τ²-bench上，对两个开源模型家族（稠密和MoE变体）、两个领域、八个单元、每个单元456个episode，在16/8/4-bit权重下进行测试。使用标准分数指标、多重比较校正、等价性检验、逐通道错误率分析、缩小错误预算（从10到2）的诊断，以及针对性的错误修复prompt来验证。

Result: 标准指标下量化看似无损（无单元格通过多重比较校正，等价性检验将最大损伤限制在±7.5分内），但过程分析揭示量化将已有的工具名幻觉失败（电信领域）放大了2.5倍（每任务+17.6点），且几乎不产生新失败（失败集各精度相关系数≥0.94，仅0.18%新事件）。分数持平是因为10个错误预算吸收了额外失败；缩小到2个错误预算时暴露17分的差距，且仅出现在量化增加错误量的单元格中。针对性的错误修复prompt精确移除了损伤。

Conclusion: 量化在标准指标下看似无损，但实际是错误预算掩盖了损伤。建议在报告任务奖励之外，同时报告逐通道错误率和缩小预算下的成功率作为额外诊断，这些都可以从benchmark已收集的日志中获取。

Abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

</details>


### [190] [Policy Gradient Steering: Interventions from Behavioral Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27574)
*Yoann Poupart,Aurélie Beynier,Nicolas Maudet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出策略梯度引导（PGS）方法，将激活引导形式化为强化学习问题，通过累积临时行为目标的梯度来构建可移除的任务向量，从而实现对大语言模型行为的动态、可组合且可逆的操控。实验在双路径网格世界、国际象棋谜题和足球环境中验证了PGS的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的激活引导（Activation Steering）方法即使在简单的双路径网格世界策略环境中也无法有效引导模型行为，这暴露了当前方法的重大局限性，需要新的引导机制。

Method: 将引导问题形式化为强化学习问题，通过在少量回滚或示范上累积临时行为目标的梯度来构建可移除的任务向量（task vector），从而实现行为引导。

Result: 在双路径网格世界中验证了PGS的校准性和可逆性；在国际象棋谜题中，独立拟合的PGS向量既能单独工作也能组合使用，且兼容的战术目标能产生累加效果；在足球竞技中，PGS能改变特定团队行为且效果可跨对手迁移。

Conclusion: 策略梯度为构建临时且可组合的行为适配提供了一种自然的接口，可应用于多种决策领域。

Abstract: Activation steering has emerged in large language models as a lightweight alternative for dynamically changing a model's behavior at inference time. However, we show that existing steering methods fail to steer even a simple policy in a two-route gridworld environment. To address this limitation, we propose Policy Gradient Steering (PGS), which formulates steering as a reinforcement learning problem. PGS accumulates gradients of a temporary behavioral objective over a small set of rollouts or demonstrations to construct a removable task vector. We first demonstrate the calibration and reversibility of PGS in a two-route gridworld environment. Using chess puzzles, we then evaluate independently fitted PGS vectors both in isolation and in combination, finding that compatible tactical objectives accumulate constructively. Finally, in competitive football, we show that PGS can alter specific team behaviors and that its effects transfer across opponents. Together, these results show that policy gradients provide a natural interface for constructing temporary and composable behavioral adaptations across diverse decision-making domains.

</details>


### [191] [The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27281)
*Lei Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"无部分学分联合对齐"（no-partial-credit joint alignment）是语言模型能力形成的关键限速步骤。通过两个指纹（短路自由装置实验和Pythia模型上的消融实验）验证了这一假设，并建立了一个速率方程来描述能力涌现的门槛效应。该方程可正向预测能力点火时间、反向预测延迟学习效应，并识别出破坏可学习性的具体机制（query-key切片初始化）及治愈方法。作者还在受控门控注意力模型中证明了机制，并引入退火方法来按计划熔化和固定电路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型中能力形成的机制是当前AI研究的核心问题之一。传统观点认为能力随规模或训练数据平滑涌现，但实际观察表明能力表现为"全有或全无"的突然出现。作者试图解释这一现象的根本原因，并找到一个可量化的统一理论框架。

Method: 作者提出一种速率方程：sites × attempts × drive × exp(-beta*K) - destruction。通过三个预注册实验（使用冻结常数）验证：（1）正向预测：能力在混合比例超过浓度阈值时点火；（2）正向预测：从先驱信号可预测点火时间；（3）反向验证：延迟学习能力随等待时间增加而恶化。同时通过消融实验（Pythia模型）和受控门控注意力模型证明机制，并通过重初始化query-key切片恢复可学习性。

Result: 实验结果显示：（1）五部分电路缺三和3部分电路缺三等待时间相近（1.19-1.37），证实等待时间取决于缺失部分数量而非电路规模；（2）在32个判别单元中，消融一个部分仅保留中位17%能力（部分学分预测50-83%，p=2e-10），而随机非部件头保留100%；（3）浓度阈值实验10/10在阈值以上点火，0/12在阈值以下不点火；（4）在6个保留模型上点火时间预测中位误差仅5%；（5）重初始化query-key切片恢复可学习性(6/6)，而value切片无效(0/6)。

Conclusion: 能力形成的核心约束是"无部分学分"的联合对齐——每个电路组成部分都必须同时正确，缺少任何一个都导致整体失败。这一机制解释了能力的门槛式涌现、延迟学习效应，并指出了标准训练监控（验证损失）的盲区。通过理解这一机制，可以设计更好的初始化策略（如重初始化query-key切片）和退火方法来精确控制能力形成的时机。

Abstract: A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scales, ablating one part leaves a median 17% of the capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, where partial credit predicts 50-83% (p = 2e-10), while a random non-part head leaves 100%.
  One rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts yields a rate equation -- sites x attempts x drive x exp(-beta*K), minus destruction -- read three ways, each preregistered with frozen constants. Forward: a capability flat at baseline ignites at a step of our choosing once the mix passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and while still flat its arrival is datable from its precursor to 5% median error on six held-out models. Backward: the delay to learn a withheld capability grows with waiting until, past a critical step, it never ignites -- yet validation loss falls smoothly throughout, so standard monitors are blind to it. We locate the damage (heads commit to the base data) and isolate the cure: re-initializing only the query-key slices restores learnability (6/6) while the value slices do nothing (0/6). We prove the mechanism in a controlled gated-attention model: occupation forces a deadline whose consequences need no mixing assumption. Completed: SGD's noise fails the fluctuation-dissipation test, so we install one and anneal, melt and pin circuits on schedule. Scope: conjunction circuits in transformers to 1.4B.

</details>


### [192] [APO: Unsupervised Atomic Policy Optimization for 3D Structure Prediction of Atomic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28553)
*Shentong Mo,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Atomic Policy Optimization (APO)，一种完全无监督的3D原子结构对齐框架，无需ground-truth参考结构。通过双奖励机制（特征分解的结构主导模式奖励+热力学稳定性奖励）和组相对策略优化，实现模型自我纠正，在晶体和抗体结构预测上超越监督基线，并提升推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配模型在原子结构预测上表现优异，但依赖与ground-truth坐标的监督偏好学习。然而，获取新型晶体相或从头蛋白质的实验标签成本极高，形成数据稀缺场景下的建模瓶颈。因此需要一种无需参考结构的无监督对齐方法。

Method: 提出APO框架：(1) 将组相对策略优化（GRPO）适配到3D原子环境；(2) 设计双奖励机制——通过样本相似性的特征分解来强化策略的主导潜在结构模式的奖励，以及强制热力学稳定性的奖励；(3) 模型在采样组内通过识别物理上合理的构型实现自我纠正。

Result: 在晶体和抗体结构预测的广泛基准测试中，APO持续优于完全监督的基线，在匹配率和结构保真度上达到新SOTA。此外，APO有效拉直概率路径，显著提升推理效率。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，内在的物理一致性可以成为比有噪声的监督坐标匹配更优越的对齐指导信号，证明无监督物理驱动对齐在原子结构预测中的可行性。

Abstract: Predicting the 3D structures of atomic systems is fundamental to advancing material science and drug discovery. While flow-matching models (, FlowDPO) have recently shown promise in this domain, their performance relies heavily on alignment with ground-truth coordinates via supervised preference learning. However, obtaining experimental labels for novel crystal phases or de novo proteins is prohibitively expensive, creating a bottleneck for structural modeling in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we propose (Atomic Policy Optimization), a fully unsupervised alignment framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth reference structures. APO adapts group-relative policy optimization to 3D atomic environments, utilizing a novel dual-reward mechanism: (i) a that reinforces the policy's dominant latent structural modes through eigen-decomposition of sample similarities, and (ii) a that enforces thermodynamic stability. Our framework enables the model to ``self-correct'' by identifying physically plausible configurations within sampled groups. Extensive benchmarks on crystal and antibody structure prediction demonstrate that APO consistently outperforms fully supervised baselines, achieving a new state-of-the-art in match rates and structural fidelity. Furthermore, we show that APO effectively straightens probability paths, significantly improving inference efficiency. Our results suggest that intrinsic physical consistency can serve as a superior guide for alignment compared to noisy, supervised coordinate matching.

</details>


### [193] [Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27283)
*Chao Peng,Zhiheng Lyu,Peijie Dong,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，提出"轨迹诱导退化"概念，指早期执行使后期工作变得更难的现象；并主张评估"长时程失败"必须通过全任务成功率与由短阶段基线预测的成功率之比（即"地平线残差"）来衡量，以区分单纯的错误累积与真正的轨迹诱导退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程基准测试中代理随着任务变长而失败增多的现象虽对部署有用，但无法解释失败的根本原因。现有评估未能区分三种可能性：普通错误的累积、更长任务中更难的决策、以及早期执行使后期任务变得更难（即轨迹诱导退化，包括"上下文腐化"）。作者认为需要更严谨的评估框架来正确归因失败原因。

Method: 提出一个评估框架：要声称"长时程失败"，必须将实际全任务成功率与由短、独立的各个阶段构建的基线预测进行比较。将二者对数比率定义为"地平线残差"（horizon residual）。比较需使用相同代理配置，并预先指定阶段、检查点、信息和预算的选择方式。残差仅表明全轨迹偏离基线，仍需针对性实验解释原因。

Result: 本文是一个概念性/方法论的立场论文，没有提供实验结果的数值数据。其核心产出是正式定义了"轨迹诱导退化"和"地平线残差"两个概念，并建立了一个评估长时程失败的分析框架。

Conclusion: 要恰当地声称"长时程失败"，基准测试必须通过与基于短阶段构建的基线进行比较来量化"地平线残差"。残差能证明全轨迹行为与基线预测存在差异，但归因仍需通过针对性实验进一步探索。

Abstract: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.

</details>


### [194] [TIER-MoE: Trust-Informed Expert Routing via Conditional Modality Risk for Multimodal Fusion in Biomedical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27289)
*Yu Chang,Anzhe Cheng,Chenwei Wu,Zhuoran Wang,Jiahao Chen,Tamoghna Chattopadhyay,Sophia I. Thomopoulos,Paul M. Thompson,Liyue Shen,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIER-MoE是一个风险引导的子空间混合专家模型，通过样本特定的模态风险估计（基于非样本训练的预测损失）与专家子空间兼容性实现稀疏模态专家路由，同时保留共享路径维持多模态互补性。在四个多模态生物医学数据集上超越了现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合研究侧重于跨模态交互和样本自适应融合，但模态在融合中的权重无法反映其是否不可靠、冗余或与特定专家不匹配。作者希望引入更细粒度的模态可靠性评估机制。

Method: 提出了TIER-MoE框架：1) 通过out-of-fold预测计算样本特定模态风险（该模态单模态预测器的预期损失）；2) 结合估计的风险与专家特定子空间兼容性进行稀疏模态-专家路由；3) 始终激活的共享路径用于保留多模态互补信息。

Result: 在涵盖阿尔茨海默病、皮肤病变恶性和视网膜分类的四个公共多模态生物医学数据集上，TIER-MoE在预测性能和概率校准上均优于最先进方法，在Macro-F1和Brier分数上有一致提升，且对外部队列具有强零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过将模态可靠性明确定义为预期预测损失，并以风险引导的方式路由到合适的专家，TIER-MoE有效地解决了"更多证据不等于更好预测"的问题，同时保持了多模态互补性。

Abstract: The promise of multimodal fusion lies in combining complementary sources of evidence, yet more evidence does not always yield a better prediction. Recent multimodal models have advanced fusion through richer cross-modal interaction and sample-adaptive fusion. However, the influence assigned to a modality during fusion does not reveal whether that source is unreliable, redundant, or poorly matched to a specialized expert. To address this limitation, we introduce TIER-MoE, a risk-guided subspace mixture-of-experts model that defines sample-specific modality reliability as the prediction loss its unimodal predictor is expected to incur. This risk is learned from out-of-fold predictions generated by models that were not trained on the corresponding sample. TIER-MoE combines the estimated risk with expert-specific subspace compatibility for sparse modality-expert routing, while an always-active shared path preserves multimodal complementarity. We evaluate TIER-MoE on four public multimodal biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease status, skin-lesion malignancy, and retinal classification. Results demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in predictive performance and probability calibration, with consistent improvements in Macro-F1 and Brier score and strong zero-shot generalization to an external cohort.

</details>


### [195] [EvoCause: LLM-Guided Evolution of Causal Graphs for Root Cause Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27290)
*Lei Zan,Keli Zhang,Shifeng Xie,Jiale Zheng,Zehao Xiao,Zhiwei Dong,Ke Zhang,Ruichu Cai,Malik Tiomoko,Lujia Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoCause框架，利用专家诊断标签和大语言模型（LLM）对因果图进行语义合理的编辑，从而优化根因分析（RCA）中的因果图学习。同时发布TeleRCA基准数据集，并在合成数据和真实电信网络数据上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代电信、云和微服务系统在组件故障时会发出关联的告警级联。RCA旨在识别每个级联的初始告警。现有方法学习观察日志中的因果图并预测零入度告警，但所学图是固定的，无法利用历史事件的专家诊断知识来改进。

Method: EvoCause通过以下步骤闭环：1）利用专家标签约束哪些告警应为源节点；2）使用LLM提出语义上合理的图编辑方案；3）通过确定性代码验证节点身份和图中无环性；4）在带标签的对齐集上保留最佳图。测试时仅用精炼后的图进行透明预测，无需LLM调用。

Result: 在合成数据上，基于PC因果发现算法初始化的EvoCause相比未精炼的PC基线，Node F1、Case EM和Graph F1分别提升11.59、9.40和4.59个百分点，nSHD降低0.2379。在TeleRCA基准上，将可读告警标题替换为匿名标识符会使Node F1和Case EM分别下降6.12和8.04个百分点，表明告警名称信息对图精炼有重要贡献。

Conclusion: EvoCause成功将专家知识与LLM语义理解能力结合到因果图学习中，显著提升了RCA性能。同时发布的TeleRCA基准（含485,681条告警事件、194种告警类型、5,621个资源）为领域研究提供了专家标注的真实生产数据资源。

Abstract: Modern telecommunication, cloud, and microservice systems emit correlated alarm cascades when components fail. Root cause analysis (RCA) aims to identify the small set of alarms that initiate each cascade. A common approach learns a causal graph from observational logs and predicts all zero-in-degree alarms in each incident-induced subgraph. However, the learned graph remains fixed and cannot benefit from expert diagnoses of historical incidents. We close this loop with EvoCause. Expert labels constrain which alarms should be source nodes but do not specify the edge edits needed to satisfy those constraints. EvoCause uses a large language model (LLM) to propose semantically plausible graph edits, while deterministic code validates node identities and acyclicity and retains the best graph on a labeled alignment set. At test time, the refined graph alone produces transparent predictions without an LLM call. We also release TeleRCA, an expert-annotated benchmark from a production telecommunication network containing $485{,}681$ alarm events spanning $194$ alarm types over $5{,}621$ resources. On synthetic data, EvoCause initialized with the PC causal discovery algorithm outperforms the unrefined PC baseline, raising Node F1, Case EM, and Graph F1 by $11.59$, $9.40$, and $4.59$ percentage points, respectively, while reducing nSHD by $0.2379$. On TeleRCA, replacing human-readable alarm titles with anonymous identifiers lowers Node F1 and Case EM by $6.12$ and $8.04$ percentage points, respectively, indicating that alarm-name information contributes to graph refinement.

</details>


### [196] [THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27303)
*Yixin Peng,Diego Collarana,Er Jin,Stefan Decker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出THGFM，一个Web规模的时序异构图融合模型，通过共享空间时序注意力与关系类型分区时序注意力双路径架构，结合类型条件非竞争门控求和融合机制和旋转时序注意力，在学术图基准上取得一致最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序异构图需联合建模跨类型结构异质性与交互时序动态。现有方法难以在参数高效的跨类型迁移与关系感知特化之间取得平衡，且通常仅在注意力核外以加法特征形式注入时间信息，未能直接将其纳入注意力得分计算。

Method: THGFM采用统一双路径架构：(1) 共享空间时序注意力分支实现参数高效的跨类型参数迁移；(2) 关系类型分区时序注意力分支实现关系感知特化。两者通过双路径关系-共享融合集成，具体采用类型条件非竞争门控求和融合机制，为共享与特化分支分配独立、类型条件的特征级门控，允许两分支独立放大或抑制而无需零和竞争。同时引入旋转时序注意力，将查询和键按相对时间半相位旋转后再进行匹配，直接将相对时间融入注意力得分。

Result: 在学术图基准上，THGFM一致超越基线图Transformer模型：六任务平均提升+3.25%，其中OAG-CS PV提升+12.37%，PF-L2提升+4.87%，PF-L1提升+1.18%，OGBN-MAG提升+4.24%，HTAG-ArXiv提升+3.73%，HTAG-DBLP提升+4.61%。

Conclusion: THGFM通过双路径架构同时兼顾参数效率与关系特化，并将时间直接编码进注意力核内，有效解决了时序异构图学习的核心挑战，验证了两者结合可带来显著的性能增益。

Abstract: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.

</details>


### [197] [Position, Not Provenance: Separating Reasoning Mediation from Sycophancy in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27304)
*Supratik Bhowal,Subhrajyoti Basu,Aritra Gir Mahanta,Anik Pal Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoT-Mediate，一个行为学框架来评估医学视觉语言模型(VLM)生成的思维链(CoT)推理是否真正因果性地影响其临床预测。通过双臂协议（重新提示vs前缀强制续写）和来源控制干预，在LLaVA-Med和MedGemma上各1000个VQA-RAD样本上评测，发现推理注入机制显著影响忠实度测量，上下文位置比声明来源更能决定模型是否使用其生成推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学VLM在回答临床问题前会生成CoT推理，但现有研究无法确定这些推理是否真正因果性地影响预测结果，而非仅仅是事后合理化。需要一种行为学方法来量化推理对预测的因果影响程度。

Method: 提出CoT-Mediate框架，包含三部分：(1) 扰动模型中一个临床有意义的属性属性；(2) 双臂协议比较重新提示证据与前缀强制续写两种推理注入方式；(3) 来源控制干预——仅改变相同推理的归属来源以区分推理中介与谄媚行为。

Result: 在LLaVA-Med和MedGemma上各1000个VQA-RAD样本评估：前缀强制续写比重新提示产生更高的中介忠实度；来源分析显示模型特有的服从行为差异；两个模型去除视觉证据后更依赖注入推理；侧向性(laterality)是最不被忠实跟踪的临床属性。

Conclusion: 推理注入机制的选择会显著影响测得的推理忠实度；上下文位置而非所声明的来源，是决定医学VLM是否使用其生成推理的首要因素。这对医学AI的可信度和可解释性评估有重要启示。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before answering clinical questions, but whether this reasoning causally influences predictions remains unclear. We present CoT-Mediate, a behavioral framework that perturbs a single clinically meaningful attribute within a model's own generated reasoning and measures whether the resulting prediction follows the edited reasoning. Our framework combines a dual-arm protocol comparing re-prompted evidence with prefix-forced continuation, together with a provenance-controlled intervention that varies only the attributed source of identical reasoning to disentangle reasoning mediation from sycophancy. We evaluate LLaVA-Med and MedGemma on 1,000 VQA-RAD samples each. Prefix-forced continuation consistently yields higher mediation faithfulness than re-prompting, while the provenance analysis reveals distinct model-specific deference behaviors. Across both models, removing visual evidence increases reliance on injected reasoning, whereas laterality is the least faithfully tracked clinical attribute. These results show that the mechanism used to inject reasoning substantially affects measured faithfulness and that contextual position, rather than stated provenance, is the primary determinant of whether medical VLMs use their generated reasoning.

</details>


### [198] [ZUNA1.1: A more flexible EEG foundation model for Denoising and Super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27308)
*Christopher Warner,Jonas Mago,JR Huml,Beren Millidge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZUNA1.1是一个380M参数的扩散自编码器，用于灵活的脑电图（EEG）信号重建。它支持可变长度序列（最长30秒）、任意数量的EEG通道、任意头皮位置，以及通道内任意时间间隔的重建，性能与早期ZUNA1模型相当，但灵活性大幅提升，并显著优于标准的EEG去噪和重建方法（如球面样条插值）。模型以Apache 2.0开源许可发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG信号重建在脑机接口和神经科学中至关重要，但现有方法（如球面样条插值）灵活性有限，难以应对多样化的重建需求（如可变通道数、任意位置、任意时间间隔）。需要一种更灵活且高性能的重建模型。

Method: 采用380M参数的扩散自编码器架构，支持可变长度序列（最长30秒）和任意数量/位置的EEG通道重建，同时能重建通道内任意时间间隔。

Result: ZUNA1.1在性能上与早前ZUNA1模型持平或更优，同时灵活性大幅提升；在广泛的重建任务上表现优异，且显著优于MNE包中常用的球面样条插值等标准方法。

Conclusion: ZUNA1.1提供了一个高灵活、高性能的EEG重建方案，并以Apache 2.0许可开源释放，有望推动EEG信号处理领域的广泛应用。

Abstract: We introduce ZUNA1.1, a 380M-parameter diffusion autoencoder for flexible EEG signal reconstruction. ZUNA1.1 is capable of reconstructing variable length sequences of up to 30s, with an arbitrary number of EEG channels at arbitrary scalp locations, and can reconstruct arbitrary temporal intervals within channels in addition to reconstructing entire channels. We demonstrate that ZUNA1.1 performs at least on par with our earlier ZUNA1 model, while being far more flexible and capable of handling a wide range of reconstruction tasks. ZUNA1.1 continues to substantially outperform standard EEG denoising and reconstruction methods such as spherical spline interpolation, which is ubiquitously deployed in the MNE package. The ZUNA1.1 model is released open source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

</details>


### [199] [Modeling Decisions in Blockchain Analytics: A Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Tree-Based vs. Sequential Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27350)
*Michał Bartnicki,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无泄漏的Sybil机器人检测框架，包含Blind-Spot协议（消除高信号合约的标签泄漏）和Transaction Grammar表示（建模钱包的节奏、EVM执行结构和意图）。实验表明，在无泄漏评估下，XGBoost优于Transformer和BiLSTM序列模型，且延迟和能耗更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Sybil检测方法存在两个问题：一是复杂序列模型计算成本高，难以用于实时监控；二是报告的性能可能因高信号智能合约的标签泄漏而虚高。作者希望回答：交易历史的哪些结构特征能区分有机用户、Sybil机器人和MEV机器人；在减少泄漏后序列模型是否仍优于树模型；交易顺序与时机哪个信号更强。

Method: 提出Blind-Spot协议消除高信号合约带来的标签泄漏捷径；提出Transaction Grammar表示法，将钱包行为建模为节奏（交易时间）、EVM执行结构和意图三个维度；对比Transformer、BiLSTM序列模型与XGBoost、SVM基线模型在以太坊参与者分类任务上的表现。

Result: 在无泄漏评估条件下，XGBoost的性能优于基于Transformer的序列模型，同时具有更低的推理延迟和估计能耗。

Conclusion: 无泄漏评估下复杂的序列模型并非必要，树模型在性能和实际部署成本（延迟、能耗）上均更具优势，为低延迟Sybil检测提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Sybil bots are Ethereum actors that imitate legitimate users to extract airdrop rewards or influence governance. Recent Sybil detection methods increasingly use deep learning and treat blockchain activity as a quasi-linguistic sequence. However, complex sequence models are computationally expensive for real-time monitoring, and their reported performance may be inflated by label leakage from high-signal smart contracts. We ask whether and how organic users, Sybil bots, and MEV bots differ in the structural complexity of their transaction histories; whether sequential models outperform tree-based tabular models once leakage is reduced; whether transaction order or timing provides the stronger behavioral signal; and whether the resulting models are practical for low-latency deployment. Our approach to leakage-aware Sybil bot detection consists of a Blind-Spot protocol and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. The former eliminates shortcuts associated with high-signal contracts, whereas the latter models wallets using rhythm, EVM execution structure, and intent. We evaluate this approach on Ethereum actor classification by comparing Transformer and BiLSTM sequence models against XGBoost and SVM baselines. We contribute a framework for leakage-aware Ethereum actor classification and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. Our results demonstrate that, under leakage-aware evaluation, XGBoost outperforms Transformer-based sequence models while providing lower latency and estimated energy use.

</details>


### [200] [Compression-Based Behavioral Similarity for Open-World Sybil Discovery on Ethereum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27370)
*Michał Bartnicki,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于压缩相似度（Gzip-NCD）的Sybil攻击者检测框架，通过从EVM交易轨迹中提取符号化交易语法（Transaction Grammar），无需代币转移记录即可区分Sybil机器人、有机用户和套利机器人钱包。该框架利用Blind-Spot Protocol筛选高信号合约，构建行为图进行Sybil发现，并在时间漂移和对抗扰动下验证了鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Sybil检测方法存在两大局限：一是图构建方法依赖钱包之间的代币转移记录，无法检测没有直接资金关联的Sybil集群；二是机器学习方法将其视为闭集分类问题，面对攻击策略频繁变化或规避战术时脆弱不堪。作者希望回答三个问题：压缩相似度能否区分不同类型的钱包而无需直接资金链路？高信号合约对Sybil发现有何增益？行为图在时间漂移和对抗扰动下有多鲁棒？

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：1) 从EVM交易轨迹中合成符号化交易语法（Transaction Grammar），分别捕获交易节奏（rhythm）、执行结构（execution structure）和功能意图（functional intent）三个维度；2) 使用自研的Blind-Spot Protocol过滤高信号合约；3) 基于Gzip的NCD（Normalized Compression Distance）构建行为图用于Sybil发现。验证方面，与监督机器学习基线对比，并进行了时间分割（temporal split）和合成伪装压力测试（synthetic camouflage stress tests）。

Result: 该框架在区分Sybil机器人、有机用户和套利机器人方面无需直接资金链路即可生效。通过时间分割和合成伪装压力测试验证了框架的鲁棒性，证实行为图在时间漂移和对抗扰动下依然可靠。核心的NCD原语无需监督训练，能够扩展可疑种子钱包而不依赖显式资金联系。

Conclusion: 作者贡献了一个泄漏感知（leakage-aware）的行为框架用于Sybil候选发现。该方法定位于开放世界区块链审计中的免训练局部发现原语（training-free local discovery primitive），而非正式的开集识别（open-set recognition）系统，为该领域提供了一种不依赖资金关系且对抗动态攻击的更鲁棒替代方案。

Abstract: Sybil attackers are Blockchain actors that adopt the characteristics of regular users to exploit airdrops or influence governance. Current methods of Sybil actor detection include constructing graphs, which requires token transfers between examined wallets. Machine learning algorithms have been employed as well, but they treat the task as a closed-set classification problem, making them vulnerable to frequent changes in attack strategies or evasion tactics. We address the following questions: can compression-based similarity differentiate Sybil bots, organic users, and arbitrage bot wallets without direct financial links? What is the effect of high-signal contracts on the discovery of Sybils, and how robust are behavioral graphs under temporal drift and adversarial perturbations? Our approach synthesizes a symbolic Transaction Grammar from EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) traces, capturing separately transaction rhythm, execution structure, and functional intent. The high-signal contracts are filtered with our own protocol, called the Blind-Spot Protocol. Gzip-based NCD is used to construct a behavioral graph for Sybil discovery. We validate this framework against supervised machine learning baselines, a temporal split, and synthetic camouflage stress tests. Ultimately, we contribute a leakage-aware behavioral framework for Sybil candidate discovery. Its core NCD primitive requires no supervised training and can expand suspicious seed wallets without explicit funding links. We position the method as a training-free local discovery primitive for open-world blockchain audits, rather than as a formal open-set recognition system.

</details>


### [201] [Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27372)
*Alexi Gladstone,Heng Ji,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Explorative Modeling (XM)这一新范式，通过分解训练循环而非生成过程，在生成模型与数据之间探索K个候选匹配并训练最优者，使预测承诺于特定模态而非模糊化。XM既能作为现有生成模型的第三种预训练轴（在参数和数据之外增加探索维度），也能作为独立的端到端生成建模范式，在图像、视频、语言等连续和离散域均显著提升性能，并在控制任务上以16-256倍更少的推理步数达到扩散模型的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的端到端训练革命已深刻影响判别式模型，但生成式模型仍无法端到端训练。根本原因在于生成建模需要处理多模态分布，现有可扩展方法都通过分解生成过程来处理多模态，这阻碍了端到端生成。作者希望打破这一瓶颈，提出一种既能端到端训练又无需分解生成过程的生成建模新范式。

Method: Explorative Modeling将分解的对象从生成过程转移到训练循环：在训练中探索K个候选匹配（模型生成与数据之间的对应关系），选择最优匹配进行训练。通过这种"探索-选择"机制，模型预测得以承诺于具体模态而非在多模态间模糊平均。该方法可作为预训练轴的扩展（增加探索维度），也可独立作为端到端的生成建模范式。

Result: 1) 探索维度的扩展在图像、视频、语言域均单调提升性能；2) 探索增益随规模增大而增加（数据扩展时从7%升至36%，模型增大时从13%升至23%）；3) FLOP效率提升4.1倍、样本效率提升6.2倍、参数效率提升47%；4) 在ImageNet上无需引导即达near-SOTA的1.43 FID；5) 在控制任务上以16-256倍更少的推理步数匹配扩散模型性能。

Conclusion: Explorative Modeling确立了作为现有生成模型新预训练轴和独立端到端生成建模范式的双重地位，证明了通过分解训练循环而非生成过程，可以真正实现端到端的生成式建模，同时提升可扩展性、效率和泛化能力。

Abstract: The deep learning revolution, kicked off by AlexNet, taught us that end-to-end training beats decomposing a problem into hand-designed stages. Generative modeling, however, has remained the exception-despite generative models being remarkably capable, they are still not trained end-to-end. This is because, at its core, generative modeling is about handling distributions with many modes, and existing scalable approaches handle this the same way, by factoring the generation procedure, which prevents end-to-end generation. In this work, we introduce Explorative Modeling, a new paradigm that instead factors the training loop, exploring K candidate matches between model generations and data, and training on the best, so predictions commit to modes rather than blurring them. We find Explorative Models (XMs) useful in two settings. First, increasing exploration adds a third pretraining axis beyond parameters and data for existing generative models-where scaling exploration monotonically improves performance across both continuous and discrete domains (images, video, and language). Notably, gains from exploration increase with scale, climbing from 7% to 36% as data scales and from 13% to 23% as models grow, with efficiency gains more than doubling at 3x the compute. Concretely, exploration improves FLOP efficiency by 4.1x, sample efficiency by 6.2x, parameter efficiency by 47%, lifts the strongest of image-generation recipes to a near-state-of-the-art 1.43 FID on ImageNet without guidance, enables scaling how end-to-end existing models are, and unlocks scaling generalization. Second, XMs enable end-to-end reconstructive generative modeling, matching diffusion on control tasks with 16-256x fewer inference steps. Together, these results establish XMs as both a new pretraining axis for existing generative models and a standalone end-to-end generative modeling paradigm.

</details>


### [202] [The Convergence Behavior of Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27383)
*Yijiang Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次为普通向量形式的Adam优化器在重尾随机噪声下建立了收敛性保证，推广了online-to-nonconvex转换框架以处理重尾鞅差噪声，并发现Adam在重尾场景下具有次优的迭代复杂度，但在已知域半径时可达到最优复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习中的随机梯度往往只具有有界的p阶中心矩（p∈(1,2]），即重尾噪声，而现有研究主要关注Adam变体在有界方差场景下的最优迭代复杂度，对普通Adam在重尾噪声下的行为缺乏理论理解。

Method: 将最近提出的online-to-nonconvex转换框架推广到重尾鞅差噪声场景；基于该推广框架，对Adam进行折现后悔分析（discounted regret analysis），无需限制性参数耦合；在已知域半径并使用其控制在线学习器输出时，进一步改进收敛率。

Result: Adam在重尾噪声下收敛到(ρ,ε)-稳定点，但表现出次优的迭代复杂度和依赖p的收敛速率；该次优性在有界方差（p=2）情况下依然存在。当已知域半径并用于控制在线学习器输出时，收敛率提升至匹配最优复杂度。

Conclusion: 该研究为Adam在重尾场景下的鲁棒性与局限性提供了新的理论洞见，表明普通Adam在重尾噪声下并非最优，但利用域半径信息可以恢复最优收敛率。

Abstract: We establish the first convergence guarantees for the plain vector-form \emph{Adam} optimizer under heavy-tailed stochastic noise. While several Adam variants are known to achieve optimal iteration complexity in bounded-variance nonconvex optimization, little is understood about their behavior when stochastic gradients admit only a bounded $p$-th central moment for some $p \in (1,2]$, a setting increasingly observed in modern deep learning. To address this gap, we generalize the recent online-to-nonconvex conversion framework to accommodate heavy-tailed martingale-difference noise. Building on this generalized framework, we develop a discounted regret analysis for Adam, without restrictive parameter coupling. Our results show that Adam converges to $(ρ,ε)$-stationary points under heavy-tailed noise. However, it exhibits a suboptimal iteration complexity and $p$-dependent convergence, a suboptimality that persists even in the bounded-variance case ($p=2$). When the domain radius is known and used to control the online-learner output, a standard setup in related literature, the convergence rate improves to match the optimal complexity. These findings provide new theoretical insight into the robustness and limitations of Adam in heavy-tailed regimes.

</details>


### [203] [FunL2O: LLM-Guided Feature Function Design for Learning to Optimize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27389)
*Bingheng Li,Junyang Cai,Yupeng Zhang,Bistra Dilkina,Jayant Kalagnanam,Dzung T. Phan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FunL2O，第一个通过LLM驱动的程序演化来自动化L2O（学习优化）中特征设计的统一框架。在FunSearch风格的循环中，LLM生成可执行的特征函数，固定评估流程重新训练原始L2O模型并衡量下游优化性能。在连续和离散优化任务上，演化出的特征一致优于手工设计的表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有L2O方法通常依赖手工设计的特征函数将问题实例映射为机器学习模型输入，这种表示设计方式繁琐且在不同领域间相对固定，缺乏自动化的表示设计方法，严重限制了L2O的泛化和自动化水平。

Method: FunL2O采用FunSearch式的演化循环：由LLM提议可执行的候选特征函数，通过固定的评估流程（重新训练原L2O模型并测量下游优化性能）来筛选和迭代，从而自动发现优于手工设计的特征表示。

Result: 在线性和二次规划（解预测和暖启动）、混合整数优化（GNN引导的backdoor分支和Predict-and-Search）等任务上，跨四种不同的LLM，演化获得的特征在所有连续和离散优化任务中一致优于手工设计的表示。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的特征演化被证实是一种通用且有效的自动化表示设计方法，为L2O流水线中的特征工程提供了首个统一的自动化框架，拓展了程序演化在优化学习中的适用范围。

Abstract: Learning-to-optimize (L2O) methods accelerate repeated optimization by training models to predict solutions, warm starts, branching decisions, or other forms of solver guidance. A critical yet largely overlooked component of these pipelines is the feature function that maps problem instances to inputs for machine learning models. Existing L2O methods typically rely on hand-crafted features, making representation design manual and largely fixed across domains. We introduce FunL2O, the first unified framework for automating feature design through LLM-driven program evolution for L2O. In a FunSearch-style loop, an LLM proposes executable feature functions, while a fixed evaluation process retrains the original L2O model and measures downstream optimization performance. We evaluate FunL2O on linear and quadratic programming tasks involving solution prediction and warm-starting, as well as on mixed-integer optimization tasks using GNN-guided backdoor branching and Predict-and-Search. Across continuous and discrete optimization tasks and four LLMs, the evolved features consistently outperform hand-crafted representations. These results establish LLM-driven feature evolution as a general and effective approach to automating representation design in L2O.

</details>


### [204] [ECG-InterpBench: Benchmarking the Interpretability of ECG Foundation Models with Matched-Scale Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27404)
*Yixuan Duan,Wei Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了ECG-InterpBench，一个系统评估心电图基础模型表示可解释性的基准。该基准使用稀疏自编码器作为标准化测量工具，在六个冻结的心电图基础模型、五个编码器深度、三个矩阵字典宽度和三个随机种子下进行受控比较，产生450个单元的可解释性图谱。基准评估了稀疏重建保真度、49个临床心电图测量的单特征可访问性与覆盖率、跨种子特征可复现性，并量化了患者采样不确定性、深度和种子依赖性变化等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的心电图基础模型基准主要评估下游预测性能，缺乏对其内部表示是否可分解、可临床解释以及可跨独立分析复现的深入评估。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器作为标准化的测量设备，匹配跨模型的容量（编码器深度和字典宽度），在受控设置下评估六个冻结的心电图基础模型的可解释性，涵盖重建保真度、临床特征可访问性、跨种子复现性等多个维度。

Result: 心电图基础模型表现出不同的可解释性特征。在MIMIC-IV-ECG上的匹配复制实验确认了重建保真度和临床可访问性会识别出不同的领先模型。

Conclusion: ECG-InterpBench通过提供容量受控且可复现的框架，补足了以性能为中心的心电图基准，使研究者能够在表示可解释性的不同维度上比较心电图基础模型。

Abstract: Existing benchmarks for electrocardiogram foundation models primarily evaluate downstream predictive performance, providing limited insight into whether their internal representations can be faithfully decomposed, clinically interpreted, or reproduced across independent analyses. We introduce ECG-InterpBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the interpretability of ECG foundation-model representations. ECG-InterpBench uses sparse autoencoders as standardized measurement instruments and matches their capacity across models to enable controlled comparisons. We evaluate six frozen ECG foundation models across five standardized encoder depths, five matched dictionary widths, and three random seeds, producing a 450-cell interpretability atlas comprising 75 exactly matched six-model comparison blocks. The benchmark evaluates complementary dimensions of representation interpretability, including sparse reconstruction fidelity, single-feature accessibility and coverage of 49 clinically meaningful ECG measurements, and cross-seed feature reproducibility. The evaluation further quantifies patient-sampling uncertainty, depth- and seed-dependent variation, and sensitivity to the sparsity parameterization. The benchmark reveals that ECG foundation models exhibit distinct interpretability profiles. A matched replication on MIMIC-IV-ECG confirms that reconstruction fidelity and clinical accessibility identify different leading models. The benchmark is accompanied by executable evaluation code, standardized manifests, cell-level metrics, and reproducibility audits. ECG-InterpBench complements performance-centered ECG benchmarks by providing a capacity-controlled and reproducible framework for comparing ECG foundation models across distinct dimensions of representation interpretability.

</details>


### [205] [Context-Informed Ship Trajectory Prediction via Conditional Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27418)
*Yuan Guan,Chandler Squires,Timothy Hu,Pradeep Ravikumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Conditional Informer，一种将船舶轨迹预测建模为条件生成任务的编码器-解码器架构。通过条件注意力机制显式编码环境（如天气）对船舶动力学的物理依赖方向，并引入模态掩码训练策略应对传感器缺失，在AIS和ERA5数据上相较基线提升15.4%预测精度，并将回退误差降低近一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer轨迹预测模型主要依赖历史运动状态，将船舶视为孤立系统，忽略了天气等外部因素对船舶动力学的物理影响。已有的多模态方法将环境和状态视为对等特征进行联合分布建模，而非编码"环境影响船舶、但船舶不影响环境"这一有向物理依赖关系。

Method: 1) 提出Conditional Informer编码器-解码器架构，将轨迹预测形式化为条件生成任务；2) 设计Conditional Attention机制，通过交叉注意力让船舶状态显式查询环境上下文，编码天气调制船舶动力学的物理先验；3) 提出Modality Masking训练策略，解决传感器数据间歇性缺失时的灾难性退化问题。

Result: 在AIS和ERA5数据上的实验表明：上下文可用时，预测精度比运动学基线和拼接式多模态基线提升15.4%；Modality Masking有效防止捷径学习，使传感器回退误差相比未约束模型降低近一个数量级。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模环境对船舶动力学的有向条件依赖关系，并引入模态掩码训练策略，能够在上下文可用时显著提升长期轨迹预测精度，同时在传感器缺失时维持鲁棒性。

Abstract: Long-term ship trajectory prediction is a fundamental capability for maritime safety and autonomous navigation. While recent Transformer-based architectures have improved forecasting horizons, they predominantly rely on historical kinematic states, treating vessel motion as an isolated system. In reality, maritime navigation is profoundly modulated by extrinsic factors like weather and constrained by static vessel characteristics. Existing multimodal approaches fundamentally model the joint distribution over states and contexts, treating environmental variables as peer features rather than encoding the directional physical dependence of vessel dynamics on environmental conditions.
  In this work, we propose the Conditional Informer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture that formulates trajectory prediction as a conditional generation task. We employ a dedicated Conditional Attention mechanism where the vessel state explicitly queries environmental contexts through cross-attention, encoding the physical prior that weather modulates - but is not generated by - vessel dynamics. Furthermore, to address the intermittency of real-world data, we introduce a Modality Masking training strategy to prevent catastrophic degradation during sensor fallback.
